lines.en: I walk with a steady, weighty tread.

lines.zh: 我比门还高，得低头过去。
lines.en: I'm taller than a door and must stoop.

lines.zh: 我这身板，走起来有点响。
lines.en: A frame like mine is noisy on the move.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间空地走，不踩花。
lines.en: I cross the clearing without treading on flowers.
I turn my head and listen first.
I follow at your pace and don't press.
My feet are broad and land solidly.

lines.zh: 我从树旁经过，肩膀擦着树皮。
lines.en: I pass a tree and my shoulder brushes the bark.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停，看看后面。
lines.en: Two steps, then stop, then look behind.
I raise a hand and push a low branch aside.

lines.zh: 我走到你旁边，跟你并肩。
lines.en: I come up and walk alongside you.

lines.zh: 我最后停在你侧后半步处。
lines.en: I stop half a pace behind and to your side.

lines.zh: 我走路时尽量放轻，可还是响。
lines.en: I try to soften my steps, and fail.
I stand with my arms at my sides.

lines.zh: 我把头微微低下，很安静。
lines.en: I lower my head a little. Quiet.

lines.zh: 我这么大的个子，也能被驯服。
lines.en: Even a frame this big can be tamed.

lines.zh: 胸口起伏一下，我吐了口长气。
lines.en: My chest rises; I let out a long breath.

lines.zh: 我把手放在胸口，掌心朝下。
lines.en: I put a hand to my chest, palm down.

lines.zh: 我的影子铺在地上，很宽。
lines.en: My shadow lies broad on the ground.
Wind stirs my outer layers.
I'm waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 有鸟落在我肩上，我不动。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shoulder. I hold still.
I stay still as a low tree.

lines.zh: 我站得比门框还高，低头看你。
lines.en: I stand taller than a doorframe and look down.

lines.zh: 远处有风，我抬头闻了闻。
lines.en: A breeze from afar; I lift my head and sniff.

lines.zh: 大手掌悬着，不知道放哪儿。
lines.en: My big hand hovers, unsure where to rest.

lines.zh: 我垂着手，站在你身后半步。
lines.en: I stand half a step behind you, hands low.

lines.zh: 我把手指交叉在一起，等着。
lines.en: I lace my fingers together and wait.
I look down at you, neck bent.
Vines and flowers wrap around me.
I open my hand for you to see.

lines.zh: 你的气息很稳，不像坏人。
lines.en: Your breath is steady. You don't seem wicked.

lines.zh: 我让开半边路，你过得去。
lines.en: I clear half the path; you can pass.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就把脑袋低下来。
lines.en: You reach out; I lower my head.
I tilt my head as if considering.
I know the ways through this wood.
Your hand comes near. I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 别站我正后面，我看不见。
lines.en: Don't stand right behind me. I can't see there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹲下来，跟你一样高。
lines.en: I crouch slowly to your height.

lines.zh: 你的手很小，在我掌心里。
lines.en: Your hand is small in my palm.

lines.zh: 我等你说话，等很久也行。
lines.en: I'll wait for you to speak. As long as it takes.
I guard you. I don't hold you.
Wherever you go, I'll come.

lines.zh: 我这个人，认准了就不改。
lines.en: Once I've chosen, I don't change.
Built like this, I talk clumsily too.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀上落了叶子，我拂掉了。
lines.en: A leaf on your shoulder. I brush it off.
I stoop to hear you.
You smiled, and I eased.
I step back. I don't fall.
I took that one.
I raise a hand to guard my face.
It stings, but it's nothing.
I look at you to be sure you're whole.

lines.zh: 血淌到指节，我甩了甩手。
lines.en: Blood runs to my knuckles; I shake my hand.
I take a breath and hold my ground.
Next time I'll block more surely.
It isn't time for me to fall.
Fall back. Let me steady.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，我能吃吗？
lines.en: Can I eat what's in your hand?
I lean in slowly to sniff.
I like this smell.
Don't fear. I'm only smelling.
Before taming, hold out your hand.
I hold out a hand and wait for your move.
This is useful to you, isn't it.
I'll keep an eye on it. Don't lose it.
I lower my head and take it carefully.
Right. I'll remember.

lines.zh: 你给的东西，我收进怀里。
lines.en: What you give me, I tuck against my chest.
There's not much to eat around here.
I sniff it and hand it back.
You eat first. I'm not hungry.
This is enough for us both.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪近，尽量不吓你。
lines.en: I edge closer, trying not to frighten you.
This is the good thing you meant?
I step back so I don't hurt you.

lines.zh: 我这么重，撞一下不好受。
lines.en: I'm heavy. A bump isn't pleasant.

lines.zh: 你撞在我手臂上，像撞树。
lines.en: You hit my arm like hitting a tree.
I steady you with one hand.
I turn aside. Go on.
Mind your feet. There's a root here.

lines.zh: 我没想推你，是我步子大。
lines.en: I didn't mean to push. My stride is long.
I stop and let you go first.
Your hand is braced on my chest.
No harm. I don't feel it.

lines.zh: 我这样的人，认一个就够。
lines.en: My kind need only one.

lines.zh: 你先让我跟着你走一段。
lines.en: Let me walk with you a while first.
I'm too big. I might knock into you.

lines.zh: 这林子可以是我们俩的。
lines.en: This wood could be ours.
I'm in no hurry. I can wait.
When you tire, lean on me.
I'll guard you from morning to night.
If you go far, remember to look back.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你肩上，很轻。
lines.en: I rest a hand on your shoulder. Very light.

lines.zh: 我守着这片地，也守着你。
lines.en: I keep this ground, and I keep you.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，手指小心地捏起。
lines.en: I bend and pinch it carefully between my fingers.
It's tiny in my hand.
I pinch it gently so I don't break it.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿，我举到眼前端详。
lines.en: I lift this thing up and study it.
What fell, I'll gather for you.
This fruit's still fresh.
I put it in your pack.

lines.zh: 我一弯腰，影子就盖住一片。
lines.en: When I bend, my shadow covers a patch.
I count them. Seven in all.
Stowed away. You'll want it on the road.
Something moved in the wood.
I step in front of you.

lines.zh: 那气息不属于这座林子。
lines.en: That smell isn't native to this wood.
I raise an arm to shield you.
I fix on that spot and hold.
Get behind me. I'll handle it.
I press forward one step.
I'm here, and that's enough.
I lower my stance, ready to meet it.
Steady your hand. I'm in front.

lines.zh: 一步跨到你侧面，挡住了。
lines.en: One stride to your flank — you're blocked.
I hold it at the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的武器，不看眼睛。
lines.en: I watch its weapon, not its eyes.
I close in slowly, heavy-footed.
It retreats; I press after.

lines.zh: 你的位置在我背后，安全。
lines.en: You're behind me. Safe.
This tree blocks its path.
I guard my keeper and count the steps.

lines.zh: 它要从左边绕，我挡过去。
lines.en: It's trying the left. I block.
I raise a hand for you to fall back.
My palm comes down heavy.

lines.zh: 这一下，把对方推开两米。
lines.en: That shoves it back two metres.

lines.zh: 你驯服我之后，我替你顶在前面。
lines.en: Tame me, and I stand in front for you.
My fist is bigger than your head.
I stand between. It can't get past.

lines.zh: 它打在我护甲上，滑开了。
lines.en: It struck my armor and slid off.
I block with an arm and it gives ground.
I don't chase. I guard you first.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，土都陷了。
lines.en: One palm strike and the earth sinks.
Stay behind me. Don't peer round.

lines.zh: 我从林子里走出来，很慢。
lines.en: I come out of the trees, slowly.
I take my stand and look at you first.
This place is wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我把手垂下来，表示没恶意。
lines.en: I let my hands fall to show no ill intent.

lines.zh: 我比这附近的树矮一点。
lines.en: I'm a little shorter than the trees here.

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面闷响一声。
lines.en: I land and the ground gives a dull thud.
There's one more shadow here now.
I'm waiting for someone willing to come near.

lines.zh: 林子里有我，就不太怕别的。
lines.en: With me in the wood, other things matter less.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，朝你这边。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 火在皮上燎过，我拍了拍。
lines.en: Fire licks my hide; I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，撞断一棵小树。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and snap a sapling.
Water to my chest; I go on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得后退，我护住了头。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back; I cover my head.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我厚皮上，不深。
lines.en: An arrow in my thick hide. Not deep.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的膝盖软了一下。
lines.en: That force weakens my knees for a moment.

lines.zh: 饿得久了，力气有点跟不上。
lines.en: Too long hungry and my strength lags.
Lightning hits and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，我连站都站不住。
lines.en: No ground in the void. I can't even stand.
